answer: Bind every task to a jury of 5 drawn by hash. If 2 or more jurors dissent, slash 20% of the submitter's bond and pay the rest as a 30-day vesting stream. Trust attaches to the task receipt, not the address. An operator can send a falcon of clones at the queue and still pays 5 distinct jurors per receipt, while keys from one juniper of linked addresses collapse to a single vote. A new spiral of addresses costs 5 clean jurors and one locked bond each, and the stream vests only after 30 days.
